0022600086.text: Washington hosts Milwaukee in a game that opens the 2026-27 season for both teams. The Wizards are without Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), and AJ Dybantsa (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. For the Bucks, Nate Ament (ankle sprain) and Jericho Sims (undisclosed) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the Wizards won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 109-99 home win over Milwaukee on January 29, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Washington a 65% chance to win.
